title: Attracthor2 Continuous Structure Search
description: An open-ended search for repeatable structure in deterministic random-like numerical streams. ESP32 nodes measure compact phase-space experiments; the Project Tool continuously explores, verifies anomalies and launches controls instead of converging to a fixed iteration limit.

progress.label: Experiments tested
progress.help: Attracthor2 has no target iteration count. The counter grows until the Project Tool is paused.

best.label: Strongest anomaly
best.help: Largest approximate standardized deviation against an iid uniform-bin reference. Phase-space samples overlap, so this is a ranking heuristic rather than a formal p-value or proof of non-randomness. Very weak generators can legitimately produce values far above 999 z.

metrics.label: Anomalous results
metrics.help: Validated task results at or above the search threshold. These trigger follow-up work; they are not automatically called discoveries.

metrics.label: Terminal leads archived
metrics.help: Bounded archive of at most 128 terminal non-control leads, deduplicated by generator/transform/bit-window/dominant metric.

details.contract: same ELF + same compact experiment input = same byte-identical result
details.strategy: continuous exploration with deterministic verify, neighbor, alternate-seed and control follow-ups
details.phase_space: 3D 16x16x16 bins from delay, delta-delay or bijective permuted-delay embeddings
details.hardware_rng: not used as a source because Microgrid consensus requires deterministic outputs
